components.name: Mark
components.description:
The mark: a microscope slide, and the green dot is the specimen. Clearspace is twice the
dot's diameter. Below 22px wide, use the dot alone.

components.name: Wordmark
components.description:
The wordmark: lowercase "specimen" and an underscore in the accent green. With cursor on,
the underscore blinks, so the system reads as still being written. One instance per view.

props.name: size
props.description: Type size in px: md 17, sm 15. Fixed brand geometry, not the type scale.

props.name: cursor
props.description: The underscore blinks like a cursor instead of sitting still in the accent green.

components.name: Button
components.description:
A mono, hairline-bordered button with the mark's 4px corner. Structure comes from the border, so the
disabled state drops the fill rather than dimming it, and the danger variant is a
fill only because a destructive confirm has to look different from everything else.

props.name: label
props.description: The text on the button. Sentence case, starting with a verb: "Notify me", "Publish", "Delete".

props.name: variant
props.description: Which job the button does. One primary per view.

props.name: size
props.description: md for forms and page actions, sm for table rows and toolbars.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Inert. Every variant collapses to the same outlined, muted form so a disabled control reads the same everywhere.

components.name: Checkbox
components.description:
A box with the mark's 4px corner, hairline border, green fill with an ink tick when on. The native input
is drawn with appearance:none so it keeps keyboard, focus ring and form semantics while
matching the Figma component pixel for pixel. Never pre-tick a consent box.

props.name: label
props.description: The text beside the box. Sentence case, no full stop.

props.name: description
props.description: One line under the label, in faint. The consent wording on a signup form is the model.

props.name: checked
props.description: Whether the box starts ticked. Uncontrolled; pass onChange to observe it.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Inert. Box and text go to the disabled colour.

args.label: Also send me occasional updates about the system
Required to submit
args.description: The visitor cannot send the form until this is ticked.

args.label: Ticked by default
args.description: Not valid consent under UK GDPR, so this stays off.

components.name: CommandMenu
components.description:
Search across every action in the product and run one from the keyboard. A modal on the
native dialog element, with the search field as a combobox over a listbox: typing filters,
arrows move the active option, Enter runs it, Escape closes. Focus stays in the field the
whole time; the active option is announced through aria-activedescendant.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether it is showing. Controlled: set it false from onClose.

props.name: groups
props.description: The commands, grouped. Content, not a Figma property: the library shows two groups.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Inside the empty search field.

props.name: emptyText
props.default: No commands match. Try another word.
props.description: Shown when nothing matches.

figma.name: emptyText
figma.defaultValue: No commands match. Try another word.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Called on Escape, on a click outside the panel, and after a command runs.

args.emptyText: No commands match. Try another word.
No commands match. Try another word.

components.name: Dialog
components.description:
A modal for a decision that blocks everything else. Built on the native dialog element,
so focus is trapped, the page behind is inert, and Escape closes it without extra code.
Flat, per brand section 06: the page dims behind the scrim token, and the panel
separates with surface fill and a line-strong edge rather than a shadow.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the dialog is showing. Controlled: set it false from onClose.

props.name: title
props.description: A question or a noun phrase, sentence case: "Delete this release?"

props.name: description
props.description: One line under the title saying what will happen.

props.name: children
props.description: The body, and the actions as a row of Buttons at the end.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Called on Escape, on a click outside the panel, and on the close control.

args.title: Publish v0.1.0?
args.description: The tokens package goes to npm and the changelog entry goes live.

args.title: Delete this release?
args.description: The changelog entry is removed. The npm version stays, because npm versions cannot be deleted.

components.name: Field
components.description:
A labelled text input with the hint and error slots every form needs. The border does
the work: line-interactive at rest (3:1, per WCAG 1.4.11), sample on focus, danger on
error, line when read-only, disabled when disabled.

props.name: label
props.description: Always visible, above the input. Uppercase label style.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown inside the empty input, in faint.

props.name: hint
props.description: One line under the input. Hidden while an error is showing.

props.name: error
props.description: Replaces the hint, turns the border danger, and is announced as an alert.

props.name: required
props.description: Adds the green asterisk and the native required attribute.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Inert. Border and text go to the disabled colour; no fill.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Displayed, not editable. Loses the interactive border, since there is nothing to find and click.

args.label: Email
args.hint: One email at v1.0, one at the Figma kit drop.

args.label: Email
args.error: That does not look like an email address.

components.name: Menu
components.description:
A list of actions opened from a button. Opens below its trigger with focus on the first
item; arrow keys move, Home and End jump, Enter or Space runs the item and closes the
menu, Escape closes it and returns focus to the trigger, Tab closes it and moves on.

props.name: trigger
props.description: The button that opens it. Must render a native button.

props.name: items
props.description: The actions, in order. Content, not a Figma property: the library shows four.

props.name: align
props.description: Which edge of the trigger the menu lines up with. end for a menu at the right of a row.

components.name: Popover
components.description:
A panel of extra content opened from a button, dismissed by Escape or a click outside.
Not modal: the page stays usable behind it. Use Dialog when the user must answer before
going on. Flat like every overlay: surface fill and a line-strong edge, no shadow.

props.name: trigger
props.description: The button that opens it. Must render a native button: the browser wires the two together.

props.name: children
props.description: What the panel holds: a short form, a set of filters, a definition.

props.name: side
props.description: Which side of the trigger it opens on.

props.name: align
props.description: Which edge of the trigger the panel lines up with.

props.name: label
props.description: The panel's heading. Sentence case, a noun: "Filters". Also its accessible name.

components.name: Radio
components.description:
One option in a set where exactly one can be chosen. Group options with a shared
`name` inside a fieldset whose legend asks the question. The only round control in the
system: it belongs to the dot family, so the selected state is the green specimen dot.

props.name: label
props.description: The text beside the circle. Sentence case, no full stop.

props.name: description
props.description: One line under the label, in faint.

props.name: checked
props.description: Whether this option starts selected. Uncontrolled; pass onChange to observe it.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Inert. Circle and text go to the disabled colour.

args.label: Team
args.description: Up to twenty seats, billed to one card.

components.name: SectionHeader
components.description:
Opens a section: the label left, optional metadata right, and the hairline that divides
sections in place of boxes or shadows.

props.name: label
props.description: What the section holds. Sentence case.

props.name: meta
props.description: Right-aligned detail in muted: a count, a date, a catalogue number.

components.name: Select
components.description:
A native select drawn to match Field: same label, hint and error slots, same border
rules. Native so it keeps the platform picker, keyboard behaviour and form semantics.
The chevron is a stroke, not a fill, so it follows the text colour.

props.name: label
props.description: Always visible, above the control. Uppercase label style.

props.name: options
props.description: The choices. Content, not a Figma property: the library shows a representative value.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown as the first, unselectable choice when nothing is chosen yet.

props.name: hint
props.description: One line under the control. Hidden while an error is showing.

props.name: error
props.description: Replaces the hint, turns the border danger, and is announced as an alert.

props.name: required
props.description: Adds the green asterisk and the native required attribute.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Inert. Border, text and chevron go to the disabled colour.

args.label: Site mode
args.hint: Flips the public page without a deploy.

components.name: Switch
components.description:
A setting that takes effect immediately. Use Checkbox instead when the choice is
submitted with a form. A native checkbox with role="switch", drawn as a pill whose thumb
is the specimen dot: the line is an inset ring so the 8px dot sits exactly 4px from every
edge and travels one spacing step (lg, 16px).

props.name: label
props.description: What turns on. Name the setting, not the action: "publish on save", not "enable".

props.name: description
props.description: One line under the label, in faint.

props.name: checked
props.description: Whether it starts on. Uncontrolled; pass onChange to observe it.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Inert. Track, thumb and text go to the disabled colour.

args.label: Signups open
args.description: The form on the home page accepts new addresses.

args.label: Maintenance mode
args.description: Set by the deploy, not here.

components.name: Table
components.description:
A plain data table. Rows separate with decorative hairlines (line), the header with
line-strong; no zebra stripes and no cell borders, so structure comes from lines as the
brand asks. Numbers align to the end with tabular figures.

props.name: columns
props.description: Column definitions, in order. Content, not a Figma property.

props.name: rows
props.description: One record per row, keyed by column key. Content, not a Figma property.

props.name: caption
props.description: Says what the table holds. Above the table, in the caption style.

props.name: density
props.description: compact for admin lists and anything scanned rather than read. Decided 10 Sep 2026: a prop on Table, not a global mode.

args.caption: Colour roles on canvas, dark theme
Colour roles on canvas, dark theme

components.name: Tabs
components.description:
Sections of one view that are read one at a time. The selected tab carries a 2px
sample bar on the shared hairline, the same device as the section headers. Arrow keys
move between tabs and select as they go; Home and End jump to either end. Give the set
a name with aria-label.

props.name: items
props.description: The tabs and their panels. Content, not a Figma property: the library shows three.

items.label: Usage
items.content: One primary button per view. Sentence case, starting with a verb.

items.label: Props
items.content: Four props: variant, size, disabled and label.

items.label: Tokens
items.content: Reads sample-fill, on-sample, line-interactive and disabled.

components.name: Tag
components.description:
The tag: 1px stroke, no fill, small caps, wide tracking. Metadata only, never a
headline. It is a label, not a control, so it carries no hover and no focus.

props.name: label
props.description: Catalogue text: "SPC-014 · BUTTON · STABLE". Rendered uppercase. Use middle dots to separate.

props.name: tone
props.description: Colour of stroke and text. sample for catalogue labels, muted for inert metadata, the four status tones for state.

components.name: Textarea
components.description:
Field for more than one line: same label, hint and error slots, same border rules.
Four rows by default and resizable vertically only, so a long answer can grow without
breaking the column it sits in.

props.name: label
props.description: Always visible, above the box. Uppercase label style.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown inside the empty box, in faint.

props.name: hint
props.description: One line under the box. Hidden while an error is showing.

props.name: error
props.description: Replaces the hint, turns the border danger, and is announced as an alert.

props.name: required
props.description: Adds the green asterisk and the native required attribute.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Inert. Border and text go to the disabled colour; no fill.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Displayed, not editable. Loses the interactive border, since there is nothing to find and click.

args.label: Release notes
args.hint: Markdown is rendered on the changelog page.

args.label: Release notes
args.error: A release needs at least one line of notes.

args.label: Published notes
args.defaultValue: Button gains a danger variant. Field reads its border from line-interactive.

args.label: Release notes
args.placeholder: Locked while the release is building

components.name: Toast
components.description:
A short notice about something that just happened. Flat: surface fill, line-strong
edge, and the status colour as a 4px bar on the left rather than a filled background,
so four tones never turn a screen into a traffic light. Put toasts in a ToastRegion.

props.name: title
props.description: What happened, past tense, sentence case: "Token copied", "Release published".

props.name: description
props.description: One line of detail or the next step.

props.name: tone
props.description: The status colour of the bar. danger is announced assertively; the rest politely.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Shows a close control. Leave it off for a toast that clears itself.

args.title: Figma check skipped
args.description: The API did not answer. The next scheduled run will retry.

args.title: Drift found
args.description: Button.size has different values in Figma and in code.

components.name: Tooltip
components.description:
A label that appears on hover and on keyboard focus, and goes on Escape or when either
ends. Flat like every overlay in the system: surface fill, line-strong edge, no shadow.
The trigger is described by it, so a screen reader hears the label after the name.

props.name: label
props.description: One short line. A tooltip names or explains; it never holds anything the user must read to proceed.

props.name: side
props.description: Which side of the trigger it opens on.

props.name: children
props.description: The trigger: one focusable element, usually an icon-only button.
